name: villager-woman
desc: FRAMING: close half-body portrait cropped at the waist, head and shoulders filling most of the frame — not a full-length figure. An ordinary river-valley villager, a woman in her mid-thirties with a plain friendly neutral expression: round cheeks, weather-pink skin, mousy brown hair braided back and pinned under a soft moss-green headscarf, a few strands loose. She wears a heather-blue woollen bodice-dress over a cream chemise with sleeves pushed to the elbow, a plain undyed apron with a mended patch at the hem, and a small woven market basket on one arm. Nobody important, entirely at home in her own street.
